name: Solo Records
source:
[B]"You know you're in love when you can't fall asleep because reality is finally better than your dreams."[/b]

Solo Records tells the story of a young music student in the port town Avenida, following his journey into adulthood with all its joys and burdens, or in other words, the challenges of falling in love.

Experience the hardships of loving and caring about another person struggling with their very own world of troubles and afflictions, created by themselves, by others, or, eventually, by yourself.

[From [url=https://ardencevice.itch.io/solo-records]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[B]“当你无法入睡时，你就知道自己恋爱了，因为现实最终比你的梦想更好。”[/b]

《独奏唱片》讲述了港口小镇阿文尼达一名年轻音乐学生的故事，他经历了成年之旅，充满了欢乐和负担，或者换句话说，面临着坠入爱河的挑战。

体验爱和关心另一个在自己的烦恼和痛苦世界中挣扎的艰辛，这些烦恼和痛苦是由他们自己、他人或最终由你自己造成的。

[来自[url=https://ardencevice.itch.io/solo-records]Itch.io[/url]]
